eps.t: Matsuri OVA - Day 1: Me, Maids, and a New Start
eps.ov: When Class 2-F has to pick a project for the school’s annual festival, the gang decides to run a restaurant! If they can make some money, they might get to upgrade their gear. Unfortunately, deadly dumplings and a kidnapping could cut into their profits.

eps.t: Matsuri OVA - Day 2: Idiots, Fireworks, and the Summoner Tournament
eps.ov: Thanks to their restaurant profits, things are looking up for Class 2-F. But if they hope to score some better gear - and keep Mizuki from transferring to another school - there’s one more challenge to be faced: a Summoner Tournament!
